llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward PoYo API helper that uses a declared API key to submit user-chosen chat payloads and shows no hidden persistence or unrelated access.

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose is to help with PoYo Gemini chat API requests, payloads, streaming, and examples; using curl, POYO_API_KEY, and PoYo endpoints is disclosed and aligned with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions limit live API calls to explicit user request, direct the agent to keep keys server-side, and warn against logging private prompts, media, or authorization headers.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only SKILL.md, an API reference, and one small shell helper; no install hook, postinstall behavior, startup task, or hidden loader was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires curl and POYO_API_KEY and can send prompt payloads to api.poyo.ai; that external data flow is expected for an API integration but users should review payload contents before sending.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No durable persistence, privilege escalation, background process, broad local file access, or credential harvesting behavior was found; the script reads one user-supplied payload path and the declared environment variable.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this only if you intend to use PoYo as a chat API provider. Keep POYO_API_KEY in a server-side environment, inspect payload files before running the helper script, and remember that prompts or inline media sent through it leave your environment for PoYo's API.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported zero issues; artifact review supports that result because the network call and API key use are disclosed and purpose-aligned.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean with no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this is supporting context only, not the basis for the verdict.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan metadata reported clean with no findings or reason codes, consistent with the small documented artifact set.
[curl-submit-script] expected: The helper script posts a user-provided JSON payload to the declared PoYo chat completions endpoint using POYO_API_KEY; it does not modify files, install software, persist, or contact unrelated destinations.
